illustrationPlan.rationale: The mandala is a single group (actor-2) that holds the outer ring, 8 mirrored sectors and the centre. Its bounding box is centred exactly on the shared centre (860,360). Animating the sectors one by one would scale or rotate each around its own centre and break the symmetry. So the whole mandala group is the one owner of the motion: it turns in from -15° (a third of a 45° sector period) and scales up from 0.8 around the fixed centre. This keeps all 8 reflections in sync and the centre never jumps. Text sits outside the repeated sectors, so the headline and its italic follow-up lines slide in from the left in a stagger after the pattern lands. The two small labels stay still.
